items.difficulty_reason: Fibre products of categories fibred in groupoids preserve faithfulness, existence of fibre products/equalizers and effectiveness of descent objects are described as quadruples (U, x, z, alpha) via Categories, 2-product-categories-over-C, and each property is verified; the last part carries a real diagram chase in which the author notices that the constructed alpha'' need not project to an identity and redoes the diagram over a common base scheme, some details omitted. Retained author proof at lines 2957-3000.
